about: The site's English messages (project.reel-bilingual): every word the pages, their metadata, data/reel.json, llms.txt and the page's script show, keyed by a semantic id. A message takes {name} arguments and {n, plural, one {# story} other {# stories}} counts (Intl.PluralRules of the page's locale; # is the count) and may mark its accent as .... Every other language translates the same keys, with the same arguments and plurals, in lang/.json `site`; node i18n.mjs --check refuses a key a language lacks, one no longer here, a different argument or plural, and a typed fact. site/build.mjs refuses a key a template, a view or the script names that is not here, and one here that nothing names. Brand names, commands and paths are not messages.

messages.made.intro: Narration, every frame, the music and the sound effects are rendered from code; nothing is filmed, licensed or generated by a video model. The same scenes are composed for each frame: the phone stacks them, the tablet sets the words beside the visual, and the desktop adds the narration as it is spoken and the use cases each scene shows.
